title: RHC Reality Identity
description: Minimal identity record for one admitted RHC history/reality. A reality is a stable identity plus an explicit parent lineage; it is NOT a per-subject availability/scoping list and NOT a state-copy/override payload. The unique root reality is the single record that declares no parent_reality_id: the root is a structural role, not a fixed identity, so any valid reality:<lower-slug> id may serve as the root of a campaign. Every other reality declares exactly one admitted parent_reality_id, and a child reality inherits its parent unchanged by default: reality identity alone clones, removes, rewrites or scopes no Entity/Hook/Scenario/Encounter/Run/system definition. Any future divergence must be represented through the real owning domain, never through this record.

parent_reality_id.description: Required on every non-root reality; forbidden on the structural root reality, which is the unique record that omits it. Parent lineage is explicit and is never inferred from similar names, dates, planes or Runs.
